content.title: iHeartRadio Music Awards 2025: Start Time, Channel, Hulu/Fox Streaming Info
content.text: Published March 17, 2025, 2:30 p.m. ET Your Friends and Neighbors- Official Trailer0 seconds of 0 secondsVolume 0%Loading ad00:2500:0002:33 Live from the Dolby Theater in Los Angeles, LL Cool J hosts the 2025 iHeartRadio Music Awards! This year’s show will feature a medley of must-see musical acts as Bad Bunny, Billie Eilish, GloRilla, Gracie Abrams, Kenny Chesney, Muni Long, and Nelly are all scheduled to perform. Lady Gaga will be presented with the 2025 iHeartRadio Innovator Award, while Mariah Carey will accept iHeartRadio Icon honors. What would an award show be without a little T-Swift? Taylor’s famed “Eras Tour” will be honored with Tour of the Century, and a prerecorded performance from the opening night of the “Eras Tour” will air during the telecast. Kendrick Lamar, Morgan Wallen, Post Malone, Sabrina Carpenter, and T-Swift lead the way in nominations, with a full list of nominees available on the iHeartRadio website. From start time to streaming info, here’s how to watch the 2025 iHeartRadio Music Awards live online. What Time Do The iHeartRadio Music Awards Start? The 2025 iHeartRadio Music Awards air Monday, March 17 from 8:00-10:00 p.m. ET on FOX. Emily Curl & EJ will host red carpet coverage, which begins at 5:30 p.m. ET on the iHeartRadio YouTube channel. How To Watch The iHeartRadio Music Awards On TV: The iHeartRadio Music Awards will air on FOX. You can watch the show with an active subscription to fuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, DirecTV Stream, or YouTube TV. FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, and YouTube TV offer free trials for eligible subscribers. iHeartRadio Music Awards Free Streaming Info: This year’s show will also be broadcast on iHeartRadio stations nationwide as well as the free iHeartRadio app. iHeartRadio Music Awards Performers: The 2025 show features performances by Bad Bunny, Billie Eilish, GloRilla, Gracie Abrams, Kenny Chesney, Muni Long, and Nelly.
